prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent 2x2 transition animation sprite sheet, 1024x1024, four equal 512x512 cells. Images 1 and 2 are the SAME approved scholar in furniture-compatible seated armchair and desk poses. Third image is the original approved heroine design. Preserve this exact adult identity, face, hair, purple ribbon, gold embroidered royal-purple jacket, ivory blouse, charcoal skirt, tights, boots and dolphin brooch. NO satchel and NO bag strap.
Character only with true alpha transparency, no furniture, background, backdrop, ground, labels or shadows. Consistent physical adult height and head size, crisp richly shaded 16-bit pixel art matching these references. Warm sunset light.
Four poses row-major:
1 full-height standing, three-quarter FRONT view facing slightly to screen right, arms relaxed naturally beside thighs; ready to sit into the armchair behind her.
2 same front three-quarter perspective, HALF-RISING from a chair: knees bent roughly 45 degrees, hips above an invisible cushion, torso leaning gently forward, hands just above thighs. Feet aligned on invisible floor, legs never folded underneath her. This must be a real sit-to-stand intermediate pose, NOT a fully seated duplicate.
3 full-height standing, three-quarter REAR view facing diagonally up-left toward a desk, arms relaxed, wavy hair and purple ribbon visible from behind.
4 same rear three-quarter perspective, halfway sitting into a chair: knees flexed 45 degrees, hips midway down, torso slightly forward and arms bent naturally; no desk or chair included.
Keep the full silhouette inside each cell with ample padding and boots aligned at cell y=480; top of standing head around y=40, all frames registered with same boot spacing and adult body proportions. Do not redesign, simplify or add decorative elements.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: image 1, the eight-frame 4x2 armchair scholar sheet. Supporting reference image 2 is the exact armchair perspective. Keep the heroine design, face, hair, clothing, book/mug, head and upper body, hips and thighs EXACTLY THE SAME in all eight poses. Keep no satchel.
Change ONLY the lower-leg anatomy: her boots currently end too high to reach the floor when her hips rest deep in this chair. Lengthen each leg BELOW THE KNEE by about 35%, preserving slender adult proportions, natural dark tights and the same brown lace-up boots. Shins should hang straight down from the knees, boots directly below knees; do NOT lengthen her upper body or stretch her face. Thighs stay approximately horizontal, hips stay on the cushion plane. She remains seated well back, not leaning forward or perched on the front edge. Keep each pose perfectly registered across all frames with identical hips, knees and boots. True alpha transparency and no furniture/background/shadow.
Use a larger 4-column 2-row canvas, 2048x1280, with equal 512x640 cells to make room for the longer lower legs; keep ample padding. All frames consistent scale, heads near y=30 and boots at y=610 within each cell. Same eight poses and ordering. Preserve richly shaded 16-bit pixel-art finish. No labels, no outlines, no text.
